verdict.rationale: Vercel documents CLI deployment: install the CLI, run `vercel login`, then the bare `vercel` command deploys from the terminal. The docs also describe a three-step CLI path to deploying an app. However, no evidence shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project; templates are mentioned only as a separate get-started option. missing for 10: a documented CLI scaffolding/project-creation command, evidence that scaffold and deploy happen in one command, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Deploy your app on Vercel in three steps: install the CLI, add agent support if you use an AI coding agent, and deploy.
Deploy and scale web applications, APIs, and AI workloads from a Git repository or the Vercel CLI.
Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI.
